articles.content: Tom Di Mino, a self-taught AI engineer and an amateur linguist, claims to have accomplished a feat that has eluded linguistics experts for over a century: deciphering a Bronze-age Minoan writing system known as Linear A. His claims are currently being reviewed by linguistics experts at Rutgers and Cambridge. While I m caveating, I will also mention that I know Tom socially. Di Mino, who is based in the Hudson Valley, has studied classical history, linguistics, and languages since he was 18. He has been reading up on Linear A for 7 years, and has visited Crete twice. He began to work on deciphering Linear A in January this year, and says the major insight came to him on May 22.
